name: Homayar Starter
tagline: Full call coverage from day one
shortDescription: The complete Homayar analysis pipeline sized for smaller teams: speech-to-text, core AI agents, quality scoring, and issue detection for up to 2,000 analyzed calls per month.
longDescription:
Most teams under 25 agents review fewer than 2% of their calls. A supervisor samples a handful of recordings each week, scores them by hand, and hopes the sample is representative. It rarely is — the calls that cost you customers are usually the ones nobody listened to.

Homayar Starter closes that gap without an enterprise budget. Upload recordings or connect your existing storage, and every call is transcribed, scored against your quality rubric, and checked for recurring issues by Homayar's core AI agent team. Within 48 hours of setup, you have a scored baseline for your entire call volume — not a sample, all of it.

Starter is built as a companion for small teams, not a surveillance layer. Scores come with the evidence behind them: the transcript moment, the issue category, the trend over time. Supervisors spend their hours coaching instead of listening, and agents see exactly what a strong call looks like. When your volume grows past 2,000 calls a month, your scorecards, history, and configuration move to Professional unchanged.
whoItsFor: Customer-service and sales leads at startups and small businesses running their first structured QA program — teams of roughly 5 to 25 agents who need full call visibility without enterprise overhead.
keyOutcomes: 100% of calls analyzed, replacing the typical 1-2% manual QA sample
Up to 70% less supervisor time spent on manual call review
First scored calls and quality baseline within 48 hours of setup
Top 10 recurring customer issues surfaced automatically every week

name: Homayar Professional
tagline: Every queue measured, every agent coached
shortDescription: The full Homayar AI agent team for mid-market operations: 10,000 analyzed calls per month, compliance and churn-risk detection, coaching workflows, and custom dashboards.
longDescription:
At 25 to 200 agents, the problem changes shape. It is no longer whether you can review calls — it is whether quality means the same thing across queues, campaigns, and shifts. Two supervisors scoring the same call five points apart is not a people problem; it is a measurement problem.

Homayar Professional applies one consistent standard to up to 10,000 calls a month. The full AI agent team runs on every conversation: QA scoring, sentiment, issue detection, compliance phrase checks, churn-risk signals, and per-agent coaching recommendations. Each team, queue, or campaign gets its own scorecard, and every score traces back to the transcript moment that produced it — so calibration debates end with evidence, not opinion.

The coaching workspace turns analysis into action. Supervisors see each agent's strongest and weakest criteria, ready-made improvement plans, and trend lines that show whether coaching is working. Custom dashboards and scheduled reports give operations leadership the numbers they ask for in the format they read, without anyone exporting spreadsheets on a Friday afternoon.

Professional connects to the stack you already run — Genesys, Five9, Twilio, Salesforce, or anything with a REST API — and adds role-based access control so the right people see the right data. Teams typically see average handle time drop 8-12% within the first quarter as coaching gets specific.
whoItsFor: CX, QA, and operations managers at mid-market companies with 25 to 200 agents across multiple queues who need consistent scoring, structured coaching workflows, and reporting their leadership will actually read.
keyOutcomes: Up to 10,000 analyzed calls per month across unlimited teams and queues
8-12% reduction in average handle time within the first quarter via targeted coaching
Scoring calibration variance between reviewers reduced to near zero
Compliance phrase coverage verified on 100% of calls, not a sample
Churn-risk conversations flagged within hours of the call ending

name: Homayar Enterprise
tagline: Unlimited scale on your security terms
shortDescription: Unlimited analyzed call volume with SSO, on-premises or private-VPC deployment, domain-tuned AI agents, and contractual SLAs for regulated, large-scale operations.
longDescription:
Banks, hospitals, insurers, telecoms, and government agencies do not adopt call analytics on a credit card. They adopt it after a security review, a data-residency conversation, and a contract that names uptime numbers. Homayar Enterprise is built for exactly that process.

Deploy Homayar in your private VPC or fully on-premises, so call audio and transcripts never leave your environment. SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning plug into your identity stack, data-residency and retention policies are configurable to your jurisdiction, and our team supports your security review with SOC 2 reports, DPAs, and pen-test documentation. A 99.9% uptime SLA with contractual response times is standard.

At enterprise scale, the AI agents are tuned to your domain. A claims-handling call is not a loan-servicing call is not a patient-scheduling call — Enterprise includes custom agent configuration and scoring models calibrated to your scripts, your regulatory obligations, and your definition of a good conversation. Volume pricing keeps per-call economics predictable whether you analyze fifty thousand calls a month or five million.

Every Enterprise deployment includes a dedicated customer success manager and a structured onboarding program: integration, scorecard calibration with your QA leads, and supervisor training. The goal is the same as every Homayar plan — a companion for your teams, not a monitoring layer over them — delivered with the controls your organization requires.
whoItsFor: Call-center operations leaders, enterprise IT, and compliance teams at banks, hospitals, insurers, telecoms, and government agencies that require security review, deployment control, and contractual guarantees.
